caption: 💌👇 Comment “snack” if you want more calm snack ideas like this one & FOLLOW for weekly “Snack Therapy” moments made simple. 🌿 Episode #3 is NEXT ...a NEW snack for calm energy and happy bellies. 🍠✨ Let’s turn morning tantrums into peaceful smiles. These soft, golden crêpe rolls are a calm breakfast dream full of slow energy, gentle sweetness, and that cozy, melt-in-mouth texture every toddler loves. 💛 🥣 Ingredients (serves 2 toddlers + 1 mama): ½ cup steamed sweet potato (about 120 g) 2 eggs 🥚 ¼ cup ( 60 ml) milk (any you use) 1 tbsp spelt flour 1 tbsp melted butter ✨ Filling: Fresh cream cheese (no added sugar) 1 small apple 🍎 diced and cooked 5 min with 1 tbsp water + pinch of cinnamon 👩‍🍳 Preparation: 1. Blend sweet potato, eggs, milk, butter, and spelt flour until silky smooth. 2. Cook thin crêpes on a non-stick pan over low heat until golden and tender. 3. Spread cream cheese, top with warm cinnamon apples. 4. Roll gently, slice into bite sized “toddler sushi” rolls. Soft. Nutritious. Comforting. Every bite feels like calm in the morning rush. ☁️💛 --- #ToddlerBreakfastIdeas #RealFoodMama #CalmSnacks #MindfulParenting
